meta.what: Milestones, in the order they were set. Dates are when the pass condition was first met, US Pacific time.

milestones.title: Harness control: macOS 26 x86 recovery boots under QEMU, KVM and OpenCore
milestones.pass: Verbose kernel log on serial, root mounted, launchd running

milestones.title: Build a kernel collection around 27.0.1's x86_64 kernel
milestones.pass: A collection holding 27's kernel and the requested kexts

milestones.title: Boot 27.0.1's x86_64 kernel
milestones.pass: 27's kernel banner on serial, then root mount

milestones.title: Map the commpage into user processes
milestones.pass: launchd survives its first commpage read

milestones.title: 27's x86_64 frameworks under macOS 26's boot daemons
milestones.pass: Multi-user boot and an ssh root shell

milestones.title: 27's own userland: 27's x86_64 dyld, shared cache and programs
milestones.pass: A root shell, and sw_vers reads 27
milestones.note: The cache had to be re-signed at 4 KiB hash pages.

milestones.title: A window on screen (hybrid image)
milestones.pass: Recovery window, Disk Utility and the installer drawn and taking input
milestones.note: Software compositor; small on-disk edits since 2026-11-04.

milestones.title: A root built only from 27.0.1's own system volume
milestones.pass: Boots with a Data volume to launchd's daemon phase

milestones.title: 27's own Sandbox kext, recompiled to x86_64, enforcing
milestones.pass: Deny probes give native 27.0.1's results

milestones.title: A kernel built from Apple's published source boots 27.0.1
milestones.pass: loginwindow and ssh, no kernel patch
milestones.note: Self-built; not Apple's kernel. Met on the hybrid image (macOS 26's recovery volume with 27's files placed over it); the 27-only root had no graphical session then (it has since drawn a login window and more: milestones L1 to L9).

milestones.title: 27's own launchd as pid 1 and xpcproxy, recompiled
milestones.pass: Boots to a running payload; the kernel's hash of pid 1 names the lift
milestones.note: Since 2026-11-24 the project's default test bases, each one standalone disk image, carry both (2 test boots each).

milestones.title: 27's own amfid, logd, logd_helper and sandboxd in place of macOS 26's
milestones.pass: Each stays up and does its job
milestones.note: logd and logd_helper replaced (3 boots, running; read-back measured on other configurations); amfid stays up (4 boots of the furthest configuration; validation partly tested). On the display test overlays used for login boots, Apple's 27 amfid was put back, named for a translator build carrying patch S, and sandboxd was named for a newer translator build: since 2026-11-25 each has run as one process all boot with no crash report (3 login boots), where both crashed there before (docs/gaps.md, B11 and B17). Whether each does its whole job is not shown, and on the default test base adopted on 2026-11-25 amfid is still macOS 26's.

milestones.title: Fold the furthest configuration into one disk image
milestones.pass: The image boots with its placed files verified

milestones.title: launchd's own sshd reachable from the host
milestones.pass: Host logins to launchd's sshd job

milestones.title: No macOS 26 piece left in the boot
milestones.pass: logd, logd_helper, the nine kexts, kmutil and the APFS EFI driver all replaced
milestones.note: logd and logd_helper replaced (3 boots); the nine kexts, kmutil and the APFS EFI driver remain. So does macOS 26's x86 boot.efi, which the condition as first written left out: 27.0.1 ships no x86 boot loader. The default test base adopted on 2026-11-25 also still carries macOS 26's amfid; the display test overlays used for login boots have had Apple's 27 amfid back since 2026-11-25 (3 boots).

milestones.title: A desktop on 27's own programs
milestones.pass: loginwindow, then Finder, with no macOS 26 program in the session
milestones.note: The pass condition is not met: there is no usable desktop yet, and that no macOS 26 program runs in the user session has not been checked (the system's amfid, still macOS 26's on the default test base, is R8's). On test overlays of the 27-only root, 27's loginwindow under translation draws the login window, a typed login is authorized, the user session starts and the first-login User Account Updater completes (milestones L1 to L4). With a per-user marker, placed by the test, that skips the first-login Setup Assistant, the Dock, Finder, SystemUIServer and Control Center start (L5), a menu bar and a wallpaper are drawn (L6) and clicks reach controls (L7); with a translator fix (patch AB) WindowManager stays up, a Finder window opens (L8) and TextEdit takes typed text (L9). Drawing is still slow or incomplete (docs/gaps.md, B22).

milestones.title: Graphics acceleration
milestones.pass: A Metal device in the guest

milestones.title: 27's login window on the 27-only root
milestones.pass: The login window drawn on screen on a test overlay of the 27-only root
milestones.note: Drawn in 2 of 2 boots of one set-up and 1 of 2 of another when nothing held the display awake: whether it appears looks like a race with the guest's display going to sleep (inferred from one boot's timing, in which SecurityAgent logged that it was showing its window one second before the screens slept). It was also drawn in each of the 19 later scored boots in which a login was typed.

milestones.title: A typed login authorized
milestones.pass: A name and password typed at the login window, and the console login authorized
milestones.note: In the first 2 boots no session followed; authorized again in each of the 17 later scored login boots.

milestones.title: The user session starts
milestones.pass: Processes of the logged-in user run after the login
milestones.note: Needed a translator fix for mapping short shared-memory objects (docs/translator-patches.md, Q2). 17 boots.

milestones.title: The first-login User Account Updater completes
milestones.pass: loginwindow reports that User Account Updater exited with success after the first login
milestones.note: Needed xpcproxy relinked with the newer link tools, so that accountsd could start (docs/boot-programs.md). 14 boots. Its Screen Time plug-in logged a failed call along the way in each.

milestones.title: The Dock, Finder, SystemUIServer and Control Center start after the first login
milestones.pass: All four running after the first login and still running, once each, at the last reading of the boot
milestones.note: With a per-user marker, placed by the test, that skips the first-login Setup Assistant; in the 2 boots in which Setup Assistant ran, the Dock, Finder and SystemUIServer never started (Control Center did). 12 boots. The Dock was drawn in 11 of 12, first seen between about 10 and 50 minutes after the login. In the first two login boots on the default test base adopted on 2026-11-25, first reported as not drawn from frames read up to 35 minutes, later frames show it drawn after 35 minutes, by about 50.

milestones.title: A menu bar and a wallpaper drawn after the login
milestones.pass: Both on screen in a frame taken after the first login
milestones.note: With the per-user marker that skips Setup Assistant (L5). First in the first completed login boot with the translator fix for app-sandboxed programs (docs/translator-patches.md, AA), in which WindowManager crashed and was restarted all through it (docs/gaps.md, B25); drawn again in each of the 8 later login boots, in which WindowManager stayed up (patch AB). 9 boots.

milestones.title: A click reaches a control
milestones.pass: A pointer click on a menu-bar item opens its menu
milestones.note: With the per-user marker that skips Setup Assistant (L5). The first was one click, on the Apple menu, which then showed its whole menu in the later frames (1 boot). In later boots clicks opened the Apple menu again (2 boots), a Finder window from the Dock's Finder icon (6 boots), a folder in Finder (7 boots), About This Mac and Control Center (2 boots). An earlier click, on a display test overlay, changed nothing on screen.

milestones.title: A Finder window drawn after the login
milestones.pass: A Finder window on screen after the first login
milestones.note: With the per-user marker that skips Setup Assistant (L5) and the translator fix that keeps WindowManager up (docs/translator-patches.md, AB). 8 boots: opened by a click on the Dock's Finder icon in 6, and from the keyboard in 2 whose Dock was not drawn yet. Its first view, Recents, showed no items; the Applications folder listed its items by name, most icons drawn as placeholders for minutes (7 boots).

milestones.title: An app opens a window and takes typed text
milestones.pass: An app started after the login opens a document window, and text typed into it appears there
milestones.note: With the per-user marker that skips Setup Assistant (L5). TextEdit, translated, opened from the Applications folder with the keyboard: its window appeared within 19 s in one boot and between about 19 and 63 s in the six others, and a word typed into it appeared (7 boots). One app and one word each; whether it does more has not been tested.
